mavacamten-hcm.claimed: The title states "Mavacamten in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy."

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The Introduction says “The outcomes pooled are” and then lists all six outcomes.
iv-iron-hf.true: Only four outcomes are pooled. The HEART-FID hierarchical composite and CONFIRM-HF walk-distance result are explicitly single-trial results with no synthesis.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: Exact quotations: “The outcomes pooled are” followed by all six outcomes; “Single cohort — no synthesis”; and Table 44, where the two k=1 outcomes read “not pooled.”

iv-iron-hf.claimed: For the hierarchical endpoint, “the form of the quantity would prevent pooling even if a second did: it counts pairs rather than participants or events, its direction of benefit is inverted ... and its interval is not at the level the others use.”
iv-iron-hf.true: Those features do not inherently prevent synthesis of compatible trial-level win ratios: ratios can be pooled on the log scale, direction can be aligned, and standard errors can be recovered from confidence intervals at their stated levels. The page itself already derives a log standard error from HEART-FID's 99% interval.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: Exact quotations: “WIN_RATIO 1.1 (99% CI 0.99 to 1.23)” and “The log point and the log standard error are DERIVED here, the standard error from the width of the printed interval on the log scale using the multiplier that belongs to that interval's own level.”

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The manuscript says “Certainty was rated with GRADE” and that “4 pooled outcome(s) were rated.”
iv-iron-hf.true: Elsewhere the page says certainty is pending, not rated, and that no certainty level is published because risk-of-bias adjudication has not occurred. The manuscript language therefore describes unfinished work as completed.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: Exact quotations: “Certainty was rated with GRADE”; “4 pooled outcome(s) were rated”; and “This certainty rating is PENDING, not rated.”

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The title and review question concern "intravenous iron" generally.
iv-iron-hf.true: Eligibility is restricted to ferric carboxymaltose or ferric derisomaltose, and intravenous iron-sucrose trials are expressly excluded. The headline therefore overstates the intervention class reviewed.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "The intervention is intravenous iron as ferric carboxymaltose or ferric derisomaltose" and "Graham's table records its iron as iron sucrose, which is neither of the two molecules this review's intervention criterion names."

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The question applies to "adults with heart failure and iron deficiency."
iv-iron-hf.true: All five contributing trials imposed left-ventricular-ejection-fraction ceilings; no contributing trial enrolled the HFpEF population. The unqualified population claim is broader than the evidence.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "its population is heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, which no contributing trial here enrolled -- every one of them set an ejection-fraction ceiling"; NCT01453608, NCT02642562, NCT02937454, NCT03036462, NCT03037931.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The Introduction says, without an outcome qualifier, "It pools 2 randomised trials."
iv-iron-hf.true: The page uses five distinct contributing trials; k=2 applies separately to each pooled outcome, not to the review-wide trial inventory.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: The Data availability table lists NCT01453608, NCT02642562, NCT02937454, NCT03036462 and NCT03037931.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: Only four eligible trials are said to have no results.
iv-iron-hf.true: The page's later cascade instead states "ELIGIBLE NO RESULTS YET 10" and also records six eligible-but-not-poolable trials. These inventory counts cannot both describe the same screening set.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "Four trials meet this review's population, intervention and comparator criteria and contribute nothing" versus "remainder_dispositions | EXCLUDED 13, ELIGIBLE NOT POOLABLE 6, ELIGIBLE NO RESULTS YET 10."

iv-iron-hf.claimed: All 29 remainder records were screened, the unscreened remainder is zero, and every record has a disposition.
iv-iron-hf.true: The reader-facing screening and disposition tables render no records, so the claimed inventory cannot be checked and the unmentioned registry candidates cannot be reconciled against it.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "Table 59. Screening of the remainder" shows only "failing limb | n | registrations" with no rows; "Table 61. Every trial, with its reason" shows only "registration | verdict | limb | reason" with no rows.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: Eligible noncontributing trials "are listed rather than left absent," and the screening section presents decisions for the excluded trials.
iv-iron-hf.true: All four eligible-noncontributing identity cells contain only "?"; the represented records are NCT07467668, NCT06929806, NCT05759078 and NCT07686692. Elsewhere, PRACTICE-ASIA-HF 2018 and IRON-CRT 2021 stand in for NCT01922479 and NCT03380520, while Toblli 2007, FERRIC-HF 2008 and Dhoot 2020 appear only as descriptors with a prior-meta-analysis link.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "? | no results posted" in Tables 12, 19, 26, 33, 39 and 43; headings "Toblli 2007", "FERRIC-HF 2008", "PRACTICE-ASIA-HF 2018", "Dhoot 2020" and "IRON-CRT 2021"; NCT01922479; NCT03380520.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: The extraction includes "per-arm counts" and "the analysed denominator," and the page supplies what is needed to rebuild the results.
iv-iron-hf.true: The effect estimates, confidence intervals and derived log standard errors make the four pooled calculations rebuildable, but several outcome rows omit their analysed denominators and display "not stated / not stated," forcing readers to infer or cross-reference analysis populations.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "AFFIRM-AHF NCT02937454 ... | not stated / not stated | 0.8 (0.66 to 0.98)"; Tables 24 and 31 similarly show "not stated / not stated" for AFFIRM-AHF, FAIR-HF2 and CONFIRM-HF.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: "Everything a third party needs to rebuild this page."
iv-iron-hf.true: The reproducibility artifact provides no canonical-object location or registration location, and the value labelled as a source-object SHA-256 is only a 16-character prefix. The numerical pools can be recreated from displayed inputs, but the full page object and screening state cannot be independently retrieved or verified.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "Canonical object | —", "Registered at | — —", and "Source object SHA-256 | 4a5ca23da2b3c4c0" in Table 45.

iv-iron-hf.claimed: "The trials' results were closely consistent with one another" because I-squared and tau-squared were zero.
iv-iron-hf.true: With only two studies, the displayed heterogeneity statistics have almost no power and cannot establish consistency; the page itself elsewhere says that two points cannot demonstrate agreement.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "With two trials this statistic has almost no power to detect heterogeneity" and "Two points cannot demonstrate agreement."

iv-iron-hf.claimed: For the HEART-FID win ratio, "the form of the quantity would prevent pooling even if a second did" because it counts pairs, has the opposite direction, and uses a 99% interval.
iv-iron-hf.true: Those features do not intrinsically prevent synthesis with another compatible win-ratio estimate: the page already derives a log estimate and standard error from the 99% interval. The valid current reason for no synthesis is simply that k=1.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: "HEART-FID hierarchical_primary | WIN_RATIO 1.1 (99% CI 0.99 to 1.23)" and "The log point and the log standard error are DERIVED here."

iv-iron-hf.claimed: "4 pooled outcome(s) were rated" with GRADE, while two single-trial outcomes were not rated because "there is no effect estimate to rate."
iv-iron-hf.true: No outcome has a final certainty rating: all six are shown as Pending. The two single-trial outcomes also do have displayed estimates—win ratio 1.10 and mean difference 33 m—so the stated reason for not rating them is false.
iv-iron-hf.evidence: Table 44 labels every outcome "Pending"; NCT03037931 has WIN_RATIO 1.1 (0.99 to 1.23), and NCT01453608 has MD 33 (11.44 to 54.56).
